name: OSCAR: Open Super-large Crawled ALMAnaCH Corpus (2019 Release)
description: OSCAR (Open Super-large Crawled ALMAnaCH Corpus) 2019 is a monumental multilingual plain text corpus created by filtering and language-classifying Common Crawl web data dumps. Developed by INRIA ALMAnaCH, the original 2019 release spans 166 natural languages and over 6.3 billion lines of text (156 billion words, 6.3TB uncompressed), serving as a foundation for self-supervised pretraining, language modeling, and linguistic corpus analysis.
